envelope.description: vscode.d.ts shim: Webview + QuickPick additive declarations

body.title: vscode.d.ts shim: Webview + QuickPick additive declarations
body.summary: Additively extend the compile-only vscode.d.ts shim (no @types/vscode) with the net-new API the panels need: window.createWebviewPanel + WebviewPanel { webview{html,postMessage,onDidReceiveMessage}, reveal, onDidDispose, dispose, active, visible } + ViewColumn, and window.showQuickPick + QuickPickItem. Leave the existing StatusBarItem.command (and every other member) unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: No existing shim member is modified or removed (StatusBarItem.command still present)
extension.ts's real vscode usage of these APIs type-checks against the shim

tests.name: tsc --noEmit compile gate proves extension.ts's createWebviewPanel/showQuickPick usage type-checks against the extended shim (and StatusBarItem.command still resolves)
